items.q: How has the S&P 500 done a year after midterms since 1946?
Why has the forward P/E fallen to 17.7?
Who is growing earnings faster than the Mag 7?
What does missing the 10 best days in 20 years cost?
items.a: It **nearly halves your annual return**—about $82K becomes $35K.

items.q: When do the best days usually happen?
items.a: **7 of the 10 best** came within **two weeks of the 10 worst**.

items.q: How often does the S&P fall 10% or more?
items.a: About **once every 18 months**; 20%+ about every 6 years.

items.q: What does Graham say you actually need to do?
items.a: **Keep buying** and **don't sell** when the market drops.

items.q: What AI bet may beat buying AI stocks?
items.a: Using AI to **increase your own output**.
